SELECT i."id" AS "itemId", i."itemCode" AS "itemCode", i."itemName" AS "itemName", i."unit" AS "unit", i."minStock" AS "minStock", COALESCE(SUM(s."quantity"), 0) AS "totalQty", COALESCE(SUM(s."quantity" - s."preAllocatedQty"), 0) AS "availableQty" FROM "Item" i LEFT JOIN "Stock" s ON s."itemId" = i."id" WHERE i."minStock" IS NOT NULL
AND i."id" = #{query.itemId}
AND (i."itemCode" LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.itemKeyword}, '%') OR i."itemName" LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.itemKeyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY i."id", i."itemCode", i."itemName", i."unit", i."minStock" HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s."quantity" - s."preAllocatedQty"), 0) < i."minStock" ORDER BY i."id" ASC
